plant.hardinessNote: Assumed hardy in all of the UK and Northern Europe, approximately -20 to -15°C; this is a genus-level estimate, not checked for this cultivar.
plant.pollination: not applicable; grown for foliage, and willows are male or female plants
plant.prune: Tolerates hard pruning; cut back in late winter to keep it compact and encourage fresh growth.
plant.resilience: Willows generally tolerate wet and heavy soils and cold winters but suffer in prolonged drought. Pests: willow aphids, sawfly larvae, willow leaf beetle, rust and anthracnose.
plant.soilWarning: Keep roots away from drains and foundations

toxicity: willows contain salicin, but I know of no RHS or common pet-poison listing flagging Salix as a hazard. 'No known hazard' is based on genus-level knowledge and should be confirmed.
